Usage: playwright-cli <command> [args] [options]

Core:
  open [url]                  open the browser

  goto <url>                  navigate to a url

  select <target> <val>       select an option in a dropdown
  upload <files...>           upload one or multiple files
  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button
  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)
  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window
  delete-data                 delete session data

Navigation:
  go-back                     go back to the previous page
  go-forward                  go forward to the next page
  reload                      reload the current page

Keyboard:
  press <key>                 press a key on the keyboard, `a`, `arrowleft`
  keydown <key>               press a key down on the keyboard
  keyup <key>                 press a key up on the keyboard

Mouse:
  mousemove <x> <y>           move mouse to a given position
  mousedown [button]          press mouse down
  mouseup [button]            press mouse up

Save as:

Tabs:
  tab-list                    list all tabs

Storage:
  state-load <filename>       loads browser storage (authentication) state from a file

  cookie-list                 list all cookies (optionally filtered by domain/path)

Network:

  request-headers <index>     print only the request headers for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.

 for(let i=0;i<14;i++){const x=150+(Math.random()-.5)*100,z=90+(Math.random()-.5)*100;const green=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(7+Math.random()*8,14),mats.green);green.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;green.position.set(x,terrainHeight(x,z)+.07,z);city.add(green);for(let j=0;j<3;j++){const trunk=addBox(city,x+(Math.random()-.5)*8,terrainHeight(x,z)+.1,z+(Math.random()-.5)*8,.45,4,.45,mats.wood);const crown=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(2.5,4,7),mats.green);crown.position.set(trunk.position.x,terrainHeight(x,z)+5.5,trunk.position.z);crown.castShadow=true;city.add(crown)}}
 // Distant ochre mesas frame the enormous playable valley.
 for(let i=0;i<22;i++){const a=i/22*Math.PI*2,r=470+Math.random()*65,x=Math.cos(a)*r,z=Math.sin(a)*r,rock=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(40+Math.random()*40,45+Math.random()*65,5+Math.floor(Math.random()*3)),mats.rock);rock.position.set(x,terrainHeight(x,z)+22,z);rock.scale.z=.8+Math.random()*.6;rock.rotation.y=Math.random()*6;rock.receiveShadow=true;city.add(rock)}
 
+// Batch the hand-built old town by material: it keeps the detailed skyline while limiting GPU draw calls.
+city.updateMatrixWorld(true);const batches=new Map();city.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh){const material=Array.isArray(o.material)?o.material[0]:o.material;const g=o.geometry.clone().applyMatrix4(o.matrixWorld);if(!batches.has(material.uuid))batches.set(material.uuid,{material,geometries:[]});batches.get(material.uuid).geometries.push(g)}});for(const {material,geometries} of batches.values()){const merged=mergeGeometries(geometries,false);if(merged){const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(merged,material);mesh.castShadow=true;mesh.receiveShadow=true;city.add(mesh)}for(const g of geometries)g.dispose()}for(const child of [...city.children])if(!child.isMesh||!batches.has(child.material?.uuid))city.remove(child);

## Objective
- Create a complete, playable 3D city-building game inspired by Sanaa, Yemen, with free building and a realistic large-scale map.

## Requirements
- 3D visual style; very large outdoor map.
- Free-form building placement.
- Realistic representation: current request refers to Yemen/Sanaa.
- Ukrainian interface.
- Include recognizable old-city architecture, roads, gardens, and landmarks.
- Desktop and mobile controls.

## Decisions
- Built as a browser game using Three.js.
- Used a 900×900 terrain, broad camera navigation, procedural height variation, old-town towers, bazaars, mosque, gate, oases, roads, and distant mesas.
- Added local browser save support.
- Used a budget, population, building count, minimap, day-cycle, rotate, demolish, and save controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html` with the game UI, toolbar, stats, minimap, and responsive styles.
- Created `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js` with the 3D scene, terrain, city landmarks, building placement, navigation, demolishing, save/load, and minimap.
- Started a local server on port `3002`.
- Added building categories: house, tower, market, mosque, garden, well, and road.

### Active
- The implementation has not received final visual verification due to browser/module issues encountered during the capture attempt.
- One browser console issue remains: `Failed to resolve module specifier "three". Relative references must start with either "/", "./", or "../".`

### Blocked
- Visual capture with Playwright was blocked initially by a missing Chromium installation, but Chromium was subsequently installed.
- Final browser verification remains blocked by the unresolved Three.js module resolution.

## Next Move
1. Fix Three.js module resolution in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`.
2. Reload `http://localhost:3002` and confirm the page has no console errors.
3. Capture a viewport screenshot and verify that 3D geometry and UI are visible.
4. Test placement, demolition, saving/loading, camera movement, rotation, and mobile layout.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Main UI and responsive layout.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`: Complete Three.js implementation and gameplay logic.

## Important Context
- A local HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Browser capture is intended through `playwright-cli`.
- Three.js imports currently mix a direct CDN URL and a bare `three` reference used for `BufferGeometryUtils`; remove the compatibility problem before final verification.
- Save data uses browser `localStorage` under key `sanaa-city-save`.
